newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys up to 35,000/T Jul-Dec'97 MTBE -source.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys up to 35,000/T Jul-Dec'97 MTBE -source.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded two six-month term contracts to buy up to 35,000 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE), industry sources said on Friday.
A CPC official declined to confirm if it had awarded two contracts, except to say, "we have awarded at least one contract."
The tenders were awarded at between minus $2 to minus $4 per tonne below average U.S. Gulf and North West Europe spot prices on a cost-and-freight basis, the official said.
The tender seeks three to five cargoes of 3,500 tonnes each for delivery between July and December 1997.
CPC awarded its previous six-month tender to Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) at around the same price.
